-- intro: Briar Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate briars, a type of prickly shrub, most commonly wild roses.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate briars at will. In order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires. These briars are good for binding and their prickles cause damage to those who come into contact with them. Additionally, the roses can produce a scent that inhibits others' senses. This element is weak to fire.
-- True Briar Spells:
    
-- spell pages: Corpse-Hunting Briar Tree; Scarlet-Braided Beautiful Battle Spear; Blue Rose Paradise; Queen of Briars
